title: Reducing glucocorticoid burden in lupus with omega-3 fatty acids: docosahexaenoic acid augments prednisone efficacy in maintaining cyclophosphamide-induced remission of preclinical lupus nephritis.
snippet: Managing lupus nephritis (LN) remains challenging due to relapses after immunosuppressive induction and toxicity from long-term glucocorticoid (GC) maintenance therapy.
